admin_intro: This module keeps the list of your partner channels and gives you a **dock**: a small panel that shows, among them, **the ones that are live right now**. You see at a glance who to raid. One click on a channel copies the raid command: you just paste it in your chat. Nothing is ever sent for you.
addr_steps:
1. Copy the address below.
2. In OBS, open the **Docks** menu, then **Custom Browser Docks**.
3. Type a name (for example “Raid”), paste the address, then click **Apply**.

The dock appears: put it wherever you like. You can also open the address in a tab of your browser.

**Keep this address to yourself**: anyone who has it can see your dock.
check_none: Everything works: nobody is live right now. Channels in your list: {n}.
renew_help: If you shared the address by mistake, create a new one. The old one stops working right away: you will need to paste the new one in OBS.
renew_confirm: Create a new address? The old one will stop working: your dock in OBS will show an error until you paste the new one.
renewed: Done. Copy the new address above and paste it in OBS.
list_empty: No channel yet. Add some with the form below: one Twitch name per line.
confirm_remove: Remove this channel from the list?
f_login_help: For example mypartner. You can also paste their twitch.tv address.
f_name_help: If you want to see another name in the dock than the one from Twitch.
f_note_help: For you only, for example “raided us last week”. It does not appear in the dock.
f_logins_help: One name per line. You can also paste the channel address (twitch.tv/name) or an @name, and paste several at once.
add_full: The list is full ({max} channels at most): remove one to add others.
add_empty: Nothing to add: type at least one name.
add_invalid: “{value}” is not a valid Twitch name: it needs 4 to 25 characters, with only letters, digits and _.
add_not_channel: “{value}” is not the address of a channel. Paste twitch.tv/name instead.
err_missing: This channel is no longer in the list. Reload the page.
dock_copy_failed: Could not copy here. Select the command below and copy it (Ctrl+C).
dock_none_to_pick: Nobody to pick: none of your partners is live right now.
dock_empty: None of your partners is live right now.
dock_empty_hint: This page updates by itself. Channels in your list: {n}.
dock_no_partners: Your list of partners is empty. Add channels in the “Twitch raid” page of your site's administration.
dock_nr_no_channel: First set up your channel in Twitch channel: no Twitch channel is set up on your site yet.
dock_nr_channel_unknown: The channel chosen in the advanced settings of Twitch raid is not one of your Twitch channels. Fix it or empty that setting.
dock_nr_setup: First set up your channel in Twitch channel: the ID or the secret of your Twitch application is missing.
dock_nr_refused: Twitch refuses your channel's application. In Twitch channel, check the ID and the secret of the application.
dock_nr_outdated: Twitch channel is too old for this module. Update it in your site's extensions.
dock_err_twitch: Twitch is not answering right now.
dock_err_rate: Twitch asks to wait a little.
dock_retry: Trying again automatically in a few seconds.
dock_denied: This address is not (or no longer) valid. Copy the dock address from the “Twitch raid” page of your site's administration.
